dct_description_sm: The main goal of this research was to determine the efficacy of filter-paper (FP) blood sampling for detecting pathogen exposure in caribou (Rangifer tarandus ssp.). FP sampling is a practical method that is well-suited to harsh environments and can be done by laypeople (i.e., hunters, biologists, others) in the field; thus, this tool can facilitate widespread disease surveillance. FP validation for progesterone (pregnancy) detection is also planned. This application of FP sampling will meet several needs of caribou biologists/researchers and help provide additional herd-health information.
dct_title_s: Validation of Filter-Paper Blood Sampling for Detection of Pathogen Exposure and Pregnancy in Caribou in areas of Alberta and Coral Harbour, Nunavut
